Subagent caught + fixed PG-version requirement (migration 11's GENERATED tsvector column needs PG ≥ 12) by bumping all integration tests to 16-alpine. Architectural shape solid: english-only tsvector in GENERATED column, GIN index for FTS, plainto_tsquery parameterized always, append-only trigger raising P0001, edit-via-new-row pattern (replaces_message_id).
